_note: Signatures only refine a diagnosis. The verdict success/failure is decided by tb.mjs on structure: a string in result.error, count === 0, page length, a blank title. A rule with requireSignature:true never fires on structure alone, and a rule with no structure at all is decided by its signatures.

gates.hint: The client's AI agent is off. Ask the user to open the Taobao desktop client, go to 设置 → AI 设置 and switch on 启用 AI 代理, then run `up` again. Nothing else can be called until they do.
Nobody is signed in to the client, and it has just opened its login page. Ask the user to sign in there, then run `up` again.

signatures: 请确保应用已加载完成
gates.hint: The client is running and answering, but the layer that executes tools never came up, and nothing from this side reaches it — retrying and `up` both run into the same wall. Ask the user to quit 淘宝桌面版 completely and start it again, then run `up`.

The client answered but has no tool executor bound. Wait a few seconds and repeat the same call; if it comes back again, ask the user to quit and restart the client, which is the only thing that rebinds it.

toolErrors.hint: This client build has no tool by that name. Run `tools` for the live registry — it is the only trustworthy list.
The CSS selector passed as `scope` matched nothing on the page that is actually open. Read without a scope first, or scan the page to see what is there.
The element is not on the page as addressed. Re-scan with scan_page_elements and use the fresh [index] — indices go stale as soon as the page changes, and every session shares one scan buffer.
The client rejected the request envelope. Check the argument JSON; pass it with --args-file when it contains quotes, newlines or a URL.
The client only opens real Taobao/Tmall URLs. Take the URL from a search result or from the browse history rather than composing one.

pathologies.message: the page returned is Taobao's anti-bot block, not the page asked for
pathologies.hint: Taobao served its block page. Repeating the call does not clear it — it has been seen to hold for fifteen tries running. Ask the user to open that page in the client window and clear the check themselves, then read again.

pathologies.message: the page has not rendered — the client returned its empty shell
pathologies.hint: Nothing has rendered yet: the text is a stub and the title is empty. Wait a few seconds and read again. A cold navigation after the client has idled takes over six seconds.

pathologies.message: the page carries almost no text
pathologies.hint: The whole page holds under 64 characters, which is what a page mid-render looks like. Wait a few seconds and read again; if it repeats, check with get_current_tab that the tab is where you think it is.

pathologies.message: search returned zero products and no error, which is also what a silent throttle looks like
pathologies.hint: A block and an honestly empty query are indistinguishable from one answer. For a keyword search use `search --keyword` instead of calling the tool directly: it paces requests, re-runs a control keyword to tell the two apart, and backs off when it is a block. An image search has no such route, so wait out `retryAfterMs` before repeating one.

pathologies.message: the scan found no interactive elements at all
pathologies.hint: A rendered Taobao page always has interactive elements, and a scan always covers the whole page — narrowing it is not what emptied this one. Wait a few seconds and scan again; if it repeats, check with get_current_tab that the tab is where you think it is.
